notes: TaskOrderV3 has 27 top-level fields and binds a raw Hash32 model ID.
Plaintext fresh-genesis requires payload_mode PLAINTEXT, zero32 input_key_commitment and an empty user_recipient_pubkey.
The 19-field order opening remains under TRUEOPEN_ORDER_OPENING_V2 and also uses the raw model ID.
Each mutation recomputes a digest after changing one encoded leaf of the V3 field list.

Each mutation row's edit states its change machine-readably, applied to the vector's typed fields: replace puts the given typed field at a dotted field path, swap exchanges two fields, remove drops one, append adds one after the last top-level field. The rule used here is: an integer leaf +1, a string leaf with "x" appended, a byte leaf with bit 0 of its last byte flipped (an empty byte leaf becomes the single byte 01), a bool flipped, a repeated field's count +1 with its elements unchanged, and a single-leaf message changed through that leaf. __order swaps the first two top-level fields, __missing removes the last and __extra appends a uint32 1. tools/verify-vector-consistency recomputes every row from its edit.
